answer: The crystal holds work receipts rather than names, so the echo of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the reef of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
